nodes.body_text: class TestHealthScoring: """Tests for camera health scoring algorithm.""" def _create_camera(self, **kwargs) -> MockCameraInfo: """Create a camera with default good values unless overridden.""" defaults = { "index": 0, "device_path": "/dev/video0", "width": 1280, "height": 720, "fps": 30.0, "exposure_auto_supported": True, "exposure_absolute_supported": True, "gain_supported": True, "white_balance_auto_supported": True, "focus_auto_supported": True, "brightness_supported": True, "contrast_supported": True, "saturation_supported": True, "sharpness_supported": True, "is_virtual": False, } defaults.update(kwargs) return MockCameraInfo(**defaults) def test_perfect_camera_score(self): """Test that a fully-featured camera gets max score.""" cam = self._create_camera() # Manually compute score using the same logic score = 0.0 # Resolution if cam.width >= 640 and cam.height >= 480: score += 0.2 # FPS if cam.fps >= 30: score += 0.15 # Exposure if cam.exposure_auto_supported and cam.exposure_absolute_supported: score += 0.2 # Gain if cam.gain_supported: score += 0.1 # White balance if cam.white_balance_auto_supported: score += 0.1 # Focus if cam.focus_auto_supported: score += 0.1 # Basic controls (all 4) basic = sum([ cam.brightness_supported, cam.contrast_supported, cam.saturation_supported, cam.sharpness_supported, ]) if basic >= 3: score += 0.1 # Non-virtual if not cam.is_virtual: score += 0.05 assert score == pytest.approx(1.0) def test_minimal_camera_score(self): """Test that a minimal camera gets low score.""" cam = self._create_camera( width=320, height=240, fps=10.0, exposure_auto_supported=False, exposure_absolute_supported=False, gain_supported=False, white_balance_auto_supported=False, focus_auto_supported=False, brightness_supported=False, contrast_supported=False, saturation_supported=False, sharpness_supported=False, is_virtual=True, ) score = 0.0 # Resolution if cam.width >= 640 and cam.height >= 480: score += 0.2 elif cam.width >= 320 and cam.height >= 240: score += 0.1 # FPS if cam.fps >= 30: score += 0.15 elif cam.fps >= 15: score += 0.1 elif cam.fps > 0: score += 0.05 # Exposure - none # Gain - none # WB - none # Focus - none # Basic - none # Virtual penalty # (no bonus for non-virtual) assert score == pytest.approx(0.15) # 0.1 (res) + 0.05 (fps) def test_medium_camera_score(self): """Test a medium-quality camera.""" cam = self._create_camera( width=640, height=480, fps=30.0, exposure_auto_supported=True, exposure_absolute_supported=False, # only auto gain_supported=True, white_balance_auto_supported=False, focus_auto_supported=False, brightness_supported=True, contrast_supported=True, saturation_supported=False, sharpness_supported=False, is_virtual=False, ) score = 0.0 if cam.width >= 640 and cam.height >= 480: score += 0.2 if cam.fps >= 30: score += 0.15 if cam.exposure_auto_supported and cam.exposure_absolute_supported: score += 0.2 elif cam.exposure_auto_supported or cam.exposure_absolute_supported: score += 0.1 if cam.gain_supported: score += 0.1 if cam.white_balance_auto_supported: score += 0.1 if cam.focus_auto_supported: score += 0.1 basic = sum([ cam.brightness_supported, cam.contrast_supported, cam.saturation_supported, cam.sharpness_supported, ]) if basic >= 3: score += 0.1 elif basic >= 1: score += 0.05 if not cam.is_virtual: score += 0.05 assert score == pytest.approx(0.65) # 0.2 + 0.15 + 0.1 + 0.1 + 0.05 + 0.05

nodes.name: TestCameraSelection
nodes.body_text: class TestCameraSelection: """Tests for camera selection logic.""" def test_select_best_camera_picks_highest_health(self): """Test that select_best_camera picks highest health score.""" cameras = [ MockCameraInfo(index=0, device_path="/dev/video0", health_score=0.5, available=True), MockCameraInfo(index=1, device_path="/dev/video1", health_score=0.9, available=True), MockCameraInfo(index=2, device_path="/dev/video2", health_score=0.3, available=True), ] best = max(cameras, key=lambda c: c.health_score) assert best.index == 1 assert best.health_score == 0.9 def test_select_best_camera_skips_unavailable(self): """Test that unavailable cameras are not selected.""" cameras = [ MockCameraInfo(index=0, device_path="/dev/video0", health_score=0.9, available=False), MockCameraInfo(index=1, device_path="/dev/video1", health_score=0.5, available=True), ] available = [c for c in cameras if c.available] best = max(available, key=lambda c: c.health_score) assert best.index == 1 def test_select_best_camera_empty_list(self): """Test that empty list returns None.""" cameras: List[MockCameraInfo] = [] available = [c for c in cameras if c.available] assert available == []

nodes.name: test_directional_coordination.py
nodes.body_text: """ Directional Coordination Verification Test for Air Mouse. Verifies hand → cursor directional coordination: - Hand moves RIGHT (increasing X) → Cursor moves RIGHT (positive dx) - Hand moves UP (decreasing Y in camera) → Cursor moves UP (negative dy on screen) - No axis inversions or coordinate system mismatches """ import sys sys.path.insert(0, '/home/shubham/airmouse') import pytest import numpy as np from dataclasses import dataclass from typing import List, Optional from airmouse.vision.hand_tracker import Hand, Landmark, HandLandmark from airmouse.vision.face_tracker import Face, FaceLandmark from airmouse.vision.head_coords import HeadCoordinateSystem from airmouse.vision.virtual_plane import VirtualDisplayPlane from airmouse.vision.projection import HandProjector, ProjectionResult from airmouse.control.cursor import CursorController, CursorConfig, SmoothingAlgorithm, SensitivityMode @dataclass if __name__ == "__main__": pytest.main([__file__, "-v", "-s"])

nodes.body_text: class MockHand: """Mock hand for testing with specific index tip position.""" index_tip_x: float index_tip_y: float index_tip_z: float = 0.0 landmarks: List[Landmark] = None handedness: str = "Right" confidence: float = 1.0 def __post_init__(self): if self.landmarks is None: # Create minimal landmarks with just index tip at the specified position self.landmarks = [Landmark(0.5, 0.5, 0.0) for _ in range(21)] self.landmarks[HandLandmark.INDEX_TIP.value] = Landmark(self.index_tip_x, self.index_tip_y, self.index_tip_z) self.landmarks[HandLandmark.WRIST.value] = Landmark(0.5, 0.7, 0.0) # Palm center at wrist self._palm_center = self.landmarks[HandLandmark.WRIST.value] else: self._palm_center = self.landmarks[HandLandmark.WRIST.value] @property def index_tip(self): return self.landmarks[HandLandmark.INDEX_TIP.value] @property def palm_center(self): return self._palm_center

nodes.name: create_mock_face
nodes.body_text: def create_mock_face() -> Face: """Create a mock face with valid landmarks for head coordinate system.""" landmarks = [FaceLandmark(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0) for _ in range(468)] face = Face(landmarks=landmarks, confidence=1.0) # Eye midpoint at camera center (0.5, 0.5) in normalized coords, depth ~0 face._eye_midpoint = FaceLandmark(0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 1.0) # Nose tip forward along -Z (camera looks along -Z in normalized coords) face._nose_tip = FaceLandmark(0.5, 0.5, -0.1, 1.0) # Forehead up along -Y in camera coords face._forehead = FaceLandmark(0.5, 0.4, 0.0, 1.0) return face

nodes.name: create_pipeline
nodes.body_text: def create_pipeline() -> tuple: """Create the full projection pipeline for testing.""" # Create face and head coordinate system face = create_mock_face() head_coords = HeadCoordinateSystem.from_face(face) # Create virtual display plane plane = VirtualDisplayPlane( distance=0.30, width=0.40, height=0.25, head_coords=head_coords ) # Create projector projector = HandProjector( virtual_plane=plane, head_coords=head_coords, use_head_coords_for_ray=True, ray_smoothing_alpha=0.0 # No smoothing for deterministic test ) # Create cursor controller (relative mode, no smoothing for test) config = CursorConfig( smoothing=SmoothingAlgorithm.NONE, sensitivity_mode=SensitivityMode.NORMAL, dead_zone_radius=0.0, adaptive_sensitivity=False, screen_width=1920, screen_height=1080 ) cursor = CursorController(config) return projector, cursor, face

nodes.body_text: class TestDirectionalCoordination: """Tests for hand-cursor directional coordination.""" def setup_method(self): """Set up the test pipeline.""" self.projector, self.cursor, self.face = create_pipeline() def test_hand_right_means_cursor_right(self): """ CRITICAL TEST: Hand moving RIGHT (increasing X) should produce cursor moving RIGHT (positive dx on screen). In MediaPipe camera coordinates: - X increases from left to right (0.0 to 1.0) - Y increases from top to bottom (0.0 to 1.0) - Z increases from near to far (negative values for forward) On screen: - X increases from left to right (0 to width-1) - Y increases from top to bottom (0 to height-1) So: hand X increase → screen X increase (same direction) hand Y increase → screen Y increase (same direction) """ # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid, "Center projection failed" # Get normalized coordinates at center u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v # Initialize cursor reference at center self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Move hand RIGHT (increase X from 0.5 to 0.6) right_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.6, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(right_hand, self.face) assert result.valid, "Right projection failed" # Get cursor movement movement = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) assert movement is not None, "Should have movement" dx, dy = movement # CRITICAL ASSERTION: Hand RIGHT → Cursor RIGHT (positive dx) assert dx > 0, f"Hand moved RIGHT (X: 0.5→0.6) but cursor moved LEFT (dx={dx})" print(f"✓ Hand RIGHT → Cursor RIGHT: dx={dx}") # Y should be near zero assert abs(dy) < 10, f"Unexpected Y movement when hand moved horizontally: dy={dy}" def test_hand_left_means_cursor_left(self): """Hand moving LEFT (decreasing X) should produce cursor moving LEFT (negative dx).""" # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Move hand LEFT (decrease X from 0.5 to 0.4) left_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.4, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(left_hand, self.face) assert result.valid movement = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) assert movement is not None dx, dy = movement # CRITICAL ASSERTION: Hand LEFT → Cursor LEFT (negative dx) assert dx < 0, f"Hand moved LEFT (X: 0.5→0.4) but cursor moved RIGHT (dx={dx})" print(f"✓ Hand LEFT → Cursor LEFT: dx={dx}") def test_hand_down_means_cursor_down(self): """ Hand moving DOWN (increasing Y in camera) should produce cursor moving DOWN (positive dy on screen). Note: In camera coordinates, Y increases downward. On screen, Y also increases downward. So they should match. """ # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Move hand DOWN (increase Y from 0.5 to 0.6) down_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.6) result = self.projector.project(down_hand, self.face) assert result.valid movement = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) assert movement is not None dx, dy = movement # CRITICAL ASSERTION: Hand DOWN → Cursor DOWN (positive dy) assert dy > 0, f"Hand moved DOWN (Y: 0.5→0.6) but cursor moved UP (dy={dy})" print(f"✓ Hand DOWN → Cursor DOWN: dy={dy}") # X should be near zero assert abs(dx) < 10, f"Unexpected X movement when hand moved vertically: dx={dx}" def test_hand_up_means_cursor_up(self): """Hand moving UP (decreasing Y) should produce cursor moving UP (negative dy).""" # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Move hand UP (decrease Y from 0.5 to 0.4) up_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.4) result = self.projector.project(up_hand, self.face) assert result.valid movement = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) assert movement is not None dx, dy = movement # CRITICAL ASSERTION: Hand UP → Cursor UP (negative dy) assert dy < 0, f"Hand moved UP (Y: 0.5→0.4) but cursor moved DOWN (dy={dy})" print(f"✓ Hand UP → Cursor UP: dy={dy}") def test_diagonal_movement_coordination(self): """Test diagonal hand movement produces correct diagonal cursor movement.""" # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, res

""" # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Move hand DOWN (increase Y from 0.5 to 0.6) down_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.6) result = self.projector.project(down_hand, self.face) assert result.valid movement = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) assert movement is not None dx, dy = movement # CRITICAL ASSERTION: Hand DOWN → Cursor DOWN (positive dy) assert dy > 0, f"Hand moved DOWN (Y: 0.5→0.6) but cursor moved UP (dy={dy})" print(f"✓ Hand DOWN → Cursor DOWN: dy={dy}") # X should be near zero assert abs(dx) < 10, f"Unexpected X movement when hand moved vertically: dx={dx}"

nodes.name: test_hand_up_means_cursor_up
nodes.body_text: def test_hand_up_means_cursor_up(self): """Hand moving UP (decreasing Y) should produce cursor moving UP (negative dy).""" # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Move hand UP (decrease Y from 0.5 to 0.4) up_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.4) result = self.projector.project(up_hand, self.face) assert result.valid movement = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) assert movement is not None dx, dy = movement # CRITICAL ASSERTION: Hand UP → Cursor UP (negative dy) assert dy < 0, f"Hand moved UP (Y: 0.5→0.4) but cursor moved DOWN (dy={dy})" print(f"✓ Hand UP → Cursor UP: dy={dy}")

nodes.name: test_diagonal_movement_coordination
nodes.body_text: def test_diagonal_movement_coordination(self): """Test diagonal hand movement produces correct diagonal cursor movement.""" # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Move hand RIGHT+DOWN (increase both X and Y) diag_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.6, index_tip_y=0.6) result = self.projector.project(diag_hand, self.face) assert result.valid movement = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) assert movement is not None dx, dy = movement # Both should be positive assert dx > 0, f"Diagonal RIGHT+DOWN: dx={dx} (expected positive)" assert dy > 0, f"Diagonal RIGHT+DOWN: dy={dy} (expected positive)" print(f"✓ Diagonal RIGHT+DOWN → dx={dx}, dy={dy}")

nodes.name: test_symmetric_movement_magnitude
nodes.body_text: def test_symmetric_movement_magnitude(self): """Test that equal hand movements in opposite directions produce equal cursor movements.""" # Establish reference at center center_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(center_hand, self.face) assert result.valid u_center, v_center = result.u, result.v # Test RIGHT self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) right_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.6, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(right_hand, self.face) movement_right = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) dx_right, _ = movement_right # Reset reference self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(u_center, v_center) # Test LEFT (same distance) left_hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.4, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(left_hand, self.face) movement_left = self.cursor.get_relative_movement_from_plane(result.u, result.v) dx_left, _ = movement_left # Magnitudes should be approximately equal (within 20%) ratio = abs(dx_left) / abs(dx_right) if dx_right != 0 else 0 assert 0.8 < ratio < 1.2, f"Asymmetric movement: right={dx_right}, left={dx_left}, ratio={ratio:.2f}" print(f"✓ Symmetric magnitude: right={dx_right}, left={dx_left}, ratio={ratio:.2f}")

nodes.name: test_coordinate_system_consistency
nodes.body_text: def test_coordinate_system_consistency(self): """Verify the full pipeline maintains coordinate system consistency.""" # Test multiple points across the plane test_points = [ (0.3, 0.3), # Top-left area (0.5, 0.3), # Top-center (0.7, 0.3), # Top-right (0.3, 0.5), # Center-left (0.5, 0.5), # Center (0.7, 0.5), # Center-right (0.3, 0.7), # Bottom-left (0.5, 0.7), # Bottom-center (0.7, 0.7), # Bottom-right ] results = [] for x, y in test_points: hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=x, index_tip_y=y) result = self.projector.project(hand, self.face) if result.valid: results.append((x, y, result.u, result.v)) # Verify monotonicity: increasing hand X → increasing u for i in range(len(results) - 1): x1, y1, u1, v1 = results[i] x2, y2, u2, v2 = results[i + 1] if y1 == y2 and x2 > x1: # Same row, X increasing assert u2 > u1, f"X monotonicity broken: ({x1},{y1})→u={u1}, ({x2},{y2})→u={u2}" if x1 == x2 and y2 > y1: # Same column, Y increasing assert v2 > v1, f"Y monotonicity broken: ({x1},{y1})→v={v1}, ({x2},{y2})→v={v2}" print(f"✓ Coordinate system consistency verified across {len(results)} points")

nodes.name: test_projection_result_contains_valid_data
nodes.body_text: def test_projection_result_contains_valid_data(self): """Verify ProjectionResult has all required fields for debugging.""" hand = MockHand(index_tip_x=0.5, index_tip_y=0.5) result = self.projector.project(hand, self.face) assert result.valid, "Projection should be valid" assert 0.0 <= result.u <= 1.0, f"u out of range: {result.u}" assert 0.0 <= result.v <= 1.0, f"v out of range: {result.v}" assert result.intersection_camera is not None, "Missing intersection_camera" assert result.intersection_head is not None, "Missing intersection_head" assert result.ray_origin_camera is not None, "Missing ray_origin_camera" assert result.ray_direction_camera is not None, "Missing ray_direction_camera" # Verify ray direction is normalized ray_norm = np.linalg.norm(result.ray_direction_camera) assert abs(ray_norm - 1.0) < 1e-3, f"Ray not normalized: {ray_norm}" print(f"✓ ProjectionResult complete: u={result.u:.3f}, v={result.v:.3f}")

nodes.body_text: class TestCoordinateSystemAxes: """Tests to verify coordinate system axis conventions.""" def setup_method(self): """Set up the test pipeline.""" self.projector, self.cursor, self.face = create_pipeline() def test_head_coords_axes_orientation(self): """Verify head coordinate system axes are correctly oriented.""" # In head coords: # +X = user's RIGHT # +Y = UP # +Z = FORWARD (from face) head_coords = HeadCoordinateSystem.from_face(self.face) assert head_coords.is_valid() # Forward should point from eyes to nose (negative Z in camera) forward = head_coords.get_forward_vector() # In camera: Z is negative forward, so forward vector should have negative Z assert forward[2] < 0, f"Forward should have negative Z in camera coords: {forward}" # Right should point to user's right (positive X in camera) right = head_coords.get_right_vector() assert right[0] > 0, f"Right should have positive X in camera coords: {right}" # Up should point up (negative Y in camera) up = head_coords.get_up_vector() assert up[1] < 0, f"Up should have negative Y in camera coords: {up}" print(f"✓ Head axes: forward={forward}, right={right}, up={up}") def test_virtual_plane_uv_orientation(self): """Verify virtual plane UV coordinates match screen orientation.""" head_coords = HeadCoordinateSystem.from_face(self.face) plane = VirtualDisplayPlane(distance=0.30, width=0.40, height=0.25, head_coords=head_coords) # Center of plane in head coords center_head = np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.30]) center_camera = head_coords.head_to_camera(center_head) u, v = plane.point_to_normalized(center_camera) assert abs(u - 0.5) < 1e-6 and abs(v - 0.5) < 1e-6, f"Center not (0.5, 0.5): ({u}, {v})" # Left edge in head coords (negative X) → u = 0 left_head = np.array([-0.20, 0.0, 0.30]) left_camera = head_coords.head_to_camera(left_head) u, v = plane.point_to_normalized(left_camera) assert abs(u - 0.0) < 1e-3, f"Left edge not u=0: u={u}" # Right edge in head coords (positive X) → u = 1 right_head = np.array([0.20, 0.0, 0.30]) right_camera = head_coords.head_to_camera(right_head) u, v = plane.point_to_normalized(right_camera) assert abs(u - 1.0) < 1e-3, f"Right edge not u=1: u={u}" # Top edge in head coords (positive Y/UP) → v = 0 top_head = np.array([0.0, 0.125, 0.30]) top_camera = head_coords.head_to_camera(top_head) u, v = plane.point_to_normalized(top_camera) assert abs(v - 0.0) < 1e-3, f"Top edge not v=0: v={v}" # Bottom edge in head coords (negative Y/DOWN) → v = 1 bottom_head = np.array([0.0, -0.125, 0.30]) bottom_camera = head_coords.head_to_camera(bottom_head) u, v = plane.point_to_normalized(bottom_camera) assert abs(v - 1.0) < 1e-3, f"Bottom edge not v=1: v={v}" print("✓ Virtual plane UV orientation: u increases right, v increases down") def test_camera_to_head_transform_preserves_directions(self): """Verify camera→head transform preserves relative directions.""" head_coords = HeadCoordinateSystem.from_face(self.face) # Two points in camera space with known X offset p1_cam = np.array([0.4, 0.5, 0.0]) # Left of center p2_cam = np.array([0.6, 0.5, 0.0]) # Right of center p1_head = head_coords.camera_to_head(p1_cam) p2_head = head_coords.camera_to_head(p2_cam) # p2 should be to the right of p1 in head coords (positive X) dx_head = p2_head[0] - p1_head[0] assert dx_head > 0, f"Camera right→left not preserved in head coords: dx_head={dx_head}" # Two points with known Y offset p3_cam = np.array([0.5, 0.4, 0.0]) # Up from center p4_cam = np.array([0.5, 0.6, 0.0]) # Down from center p3_head = head_coords.camera_to_head(p3_cam) p4_head = head_coords.camera_to_head(p4_cam) # p4 should be below p3 in head coords (negative Y) dy_head = p4_head[1] - p3_head[1] assert dy_head < 0, f"Camera down→up not preserved in head coords: dy_head={dy_head}" print(f"✓ Transform preserves directions: dx_head={dx_head:.3f}, dy_head={dy_head:.3f}")

nodes.body_text: class TestKalmanPredictor: """Test KalmanPredictor class.""" def test_initialization(self): """Test predictor initialization.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() assert not predictor.is_initialized() def test_initialize_with_position(self): """Test initialization with position only.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.5, 0.5)) assert predictor.is_initialized() pos = predictor.get_position() assert abs(pos[0] - 0.5) < 1e-6 assert abs(pos[1] - 0.5) < 1e-6 vel = predictor.get_velocity() assert abs(vel[0]) < 1e-6 assert abs(vel[1]) < 1e-6 def test_initialize_with_velocity(self): """Test initialization with position and velocity.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.5, 0.5), (0.1, -0.1)) assert predictor.is_initialized() pos = predictor.get_position() assert abs(pos[0] - 0.5) < 1e-6 assert abs(pos[1] - 0.5) < 1e-6 vel = predictor.get_velocity() assert abs(vel[0] - 0.1) < 1e-6 assert abs(vel[1] + 0.1) < 1e-6 def test_predict_without_initialize(self): """Test prediction before initialization returns zero.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() pos = predictor.predict(0.016) assert pos == (0.0, 0.0) def test_predict_after_initialize(self): """Test prediction after initialization.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.5, 0.5), (0.1, 0.0)) pos = predictor.predict(0.1) # 100ms ahead # Should predict position + velocity * dt assert abs(pos[0] - 0.51) < 1e-6 assert abs(pos[1] - 0.5) < 1e-6 def test_update_with_measurement(self): """Test update with new measurement.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.5, 0.5)) updated = predictor.update((0.6, 0.6)) # Update should move towards measurement assert abs(updated[0] - 0.6) < 0.1 assert abs(updated[1] - 0.6) < 0.1 def test_update_converges(self): """Test that repeated updates converge to measurement.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.0, 0.0)) # Apply multiple updates with same measurement for _ in range(10): updated = predictor.update((1.0, 1.0)) # Should be very close to (1, 1) pos = predictor.get_position() assert abs(pos[0] - 1.0) < 0.01 assert abs(pos[1] - 1.0) < 0.01 def test_get_state(self): """Test getting full state.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.5, 0.5), (0.1, 0.2)) u, v, u_vel, v_vel = predictor.get_state() assert abs(u - 0.5) < 1e-6 assert abs(v - 0.5) < 1e-6 assert abs(u_vel - 0.1) < 1e-6 assert abs(v_vel - 0.2) < 1e-6 def test_predict_ahead(self): """Test predicting ahead without updating state.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.5, 0.5), (1.0, 0.0)) # 1.0 units/sec velocity pred = predictor.predict_ahead(0.05) # 50ms ahead (within max_prediction_dt) # Should predict position + velocity * dt = 0.5 + 1.0 * 0.05 = 0.55 assert abs(pred[0] - 0.55) < 0.01 assert abs(pred[1] - 0.5) < 0.01 # State should not be modified assert abs(predictor.get_position()[0] - 0.5) < 1e-6 def test_reset(self): """Test reset clears state.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.5, 0.5), (0.1, 0.1)) predictor.reset() assert not predictor.is_initialized() def test_velocity_estimation(self): """Test velocity is estimated from measurements.""" predictor = KalmanPredictor() predictor.initialize((0.0, 0.0)) # Simulate moving right at ~0.1 units/frame for i in range(10): t = i * 0.016 predictor.update((0.1 * i * 0.016, 0.0), t) vel = predictor.get_velocity() # Should estimate positive velocity assert vel[0] > 0

nodes.name: TestPredictiveTrackingIntegration
nodes.body_text: class TestPredictiveTrackingIntegration: """Integration tests for predictive tracking with tracking processor.""" def test_predictive_tracking_smoothes_noisy_signal(self): """Test that predictive tracking smoothes noisy measurements.""" config = KalmanConfig( process_noise_position=1e-4, process_noise_velocity=1e-3, measurement_noise=1e-2 # Higher measurement noise ) processor = PredictiveTrackingProcessor(config) # Add noisy measurements around (0.5, 0.5) np.random.seed(42) noisy_positions = [(0.5 + np.random.normal(0, 0.02), 0.5 + np.random.normal(0, 0.02)) for _ in range(50)] filtered_positions = [] for pos in noisy_positions: filtered = processor.process(pos, time.time()) filtered_positions.append(filtered) # Calculate variance of filtered positions filtered_array = np.array(filtered_positions) var_u = np.var(filtered_array[:, 0]) var_v = np.var(filtered_array[:, 1]) # Variance should be significantly reduced assert var_u < 0.001 # Much less than measurement noise variance (0.0004) assert var_v < 0.001 def test_predictive_tracking_tracks_constant_velocity(self): """Test that predictive tracking handles constant velocity motion.""" config = KalmanConfig( process_noise_position=1e-4, process_noise_velocity=1e-3, measurement_noise=1e-4 ) processor = PredictiveTrackingProcessor(config) # Simulate constant velocity movement for i in range(20): t = i * 0.016 pos = (0.1 * t, 0.0) # Moving right at 0.1 units/sec processor.process(pos, t) vel = processor.get_velocity() # Should estimate velocity close to 0.1 assert abs(vel[0] - 0.1) < 0.05 assert abs(vel[1]) < 0.05 def test_predictive_tracking_prediction_during_occlusion(self): """Test prediction during brief tracking loss.""" config = KalmanConfig( process_noise_position=1e-4, process_noise_velocity=1e-3, measurement_noise=1e-4 ) processor = PredictiveTrackingProcessor(config) # Establish motion for i in range(10): t = i * 0.016 pos = (0.1 * t, 0.0) processor.process(pos, t) # Tracking lost for 100ms - predict last_time = 10 * 0.016 prev_pos = 0.0 for i in range(6): # ~100ms at 60fps t = last_time + i * 0.016 result = processor.process(None, t) # Should continue moving (position increases) assert result[0] >= prev_pos prev_pos = result[0] # Tracking resumes result = processor.process((0.26, 0.0), last_time + 0.1) # Should be close to where prediction was assert abs(result[0] - 0.26) < 0.05

""" import time import threading import numpy as np import pytest from unittest.mock import Mock, patch, MagicMock from dataclasses import dataclass from typing import List, Optional, Tuple @dataclass @dataclass @dataclass if __name__ == "__main__": pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])

nodes.body_text: class MockHand: landmarks: List[MockLandmark] = None handedness: str = "Right" score: float = 1.0 def __post_init__(self): if self.landmarks is None: # Create 21 landmarks for MediaPipe hand model self.landmarks = [MockLandmark() for _ in range(21)] # Finger states for gesture detection self._finger_states = { "thumb": True, "index": True, "middle": True, "ring": False, "pinky": False, } @property def index_tip(self): return self.landmarks[8] @property def middle_tip(self): return self.landmarks[12] @property def ring_tip(self): return self.landmarks[16] @property def pinky_tip(self): return self.landmarks[20] @property def thumb_tip(self): return self.landmarks[4] def pinch_distance(self, finger1: str, finger2: str) -> float: # Simplified mock if finger1 == "thumb" and finger2 == "index": return 0.03 # Pinch detected if finger1 == "thumb" and finger2 == "middle": return 0.03 # Pinch detected if finger1 == "thumb" and finger2 == "ring": return 0.03 # Pinch detected return 0.1 # Not pinching def is_scroll_gesture(self) -> bool: """Check if hand is in scroll gesture (index + middle extended).""" if not self._finger_states: return False return (self._finger_states.get("index", False) and self._finger_states.get("middle", False) and not self._finger_states.get("ring", False) and not self._finger_states.get("pinky", False)) def is_fist(self) -> bool: """Check if hand is in fist position (all fingers folded).""" return not any(self._finger_states.values()) if self._finger_states else False @property def finger_states(self): return self._finger_states

nodes.body_text: class TestGestureStateMachineStress: """Stress tests for gesture state machine.""" def test_rapid_state_transitions(self): """Test rapid state transitions don't cause instability.""" from airmouse.vision.gesture_state_machine import GestureStateMachine, GestureState, GestureType machine = GestureStateMachine() hand = MockHand() # Rapid transitions between states for i in range(100): machine.process(hand, time.time()) machine.process(None, time.time()) # Should end up in IDLE or COOLDOWN state = machine.get_all_states()[GestureType.LEFT_CLICK] assert state in (GestureState.IDLE, GestureState.COOLDOWN) def test_concurrent_gestures(self): """Test multiple concurrent gestures on different hands.""" from airmouse.vision.gesture_state_machine import GestureStateMachine, GestureType, GestureState machine = GestureStateMachine() left_hand = MockHand(handedness="Left") right_hand = MockHand(handedness="Right") # Activate left click on left hand machine.process(left_hand, time.time()) # Activate right click on right hand machine.process(right_hand, time.time()) left_state = machine.get_all_states()[GestureType.LEFT_CLICK] right_state = machine.get_all_states()[GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK] # Both should be active assert left_state in (GestureState.DETECTING, GestureState.CONFIRMED, GestureState.ACTIVE) assert right_state in (GestureState.DETECTING, GestureState.CONFIRMED, GestureState.ACTIVE)

nodes.body_text: class TestCursorControllerStress: """Stress tests for cursor controller.""" def test_rapid_position_changes(self): """Test cursor handles rapid position changes without drift.""" from airmouse.control.cursor import CursorController, CursorConfig config = CursorConfig() controller = CursorController(config) # Simulate rapid cursor movements for i in range(1000): x = 0.5 + 0.01 * np.sin(i * 0.1) y = 0.5 + 0.01 * np.cos(i * 0.1) movement = controller.get_relative_movement_from_plane(x, y) # Movement can be None if within dead zone, or (0, 0) for no movement if movement is not None: dx, dy = movement # Movement should be reasonable assert abs(dx) < 100 assert abs(dy) < 100 def test_dead_zone_stress(self): """Test dead zone handling under rapid small movements.""" from airmouse.control.cursor import CursorController, CursorConfig config = CursorConfig(dead_zone_radius=0.01) controller = CursorController(config) # Small movements within dead zone for i in range(1000): x = 0.5 + 0.001 * np.sin(i) y = 0.5 + 0.001 * np.cos(i) movement = controller.get_relative_movement_from_plane(x, y) assert movement == (0, 0) or (movement[0] == 0 and movement[1] == 0) def test_hold_position_stress(self): """Test cursor hold position during rapid transitions.""" from airmouse.control.cursor import CursorController, CursorConfig config = CursorConfig() controller = CursorController(config) # Set initial reference controller.get_relative_movement_from_plane(0.5, 0.5) # Set hold position controller.set_cursor_hold_position((0.5, 0.5)) # Try to move while holding - should stay at hold position for i in range(100): x = 0.5 + 0.05 * np.sin(i * 0.1) y = 0.5 + 0.05 * np.cos(i * 0.1) movement = controller.get_relative_movement_from_plane(x, y) assert movement == (0, 0) or (movement[0] == 0 and movement[1] == 0) # Release hold controller.set_cursor_hold_position(None) # Now movement should work movement = controller.get_relative_movement_from_plane(0.55, 0.55) assert movement != (0, 0)

""" Gesture Filtering Module for Air Mouse Implements comprehensive false gesture detection reduction: 1. Multi-frame confirmation history (8-12 frames, 5+ consecutive frames) 2. Dynamic per-gesture confidence thresholding 3. Finger extension state stability filter """ import time import logging from dataclasses import dataclass, field from typing import Optional, Dict, List, Tuple, TYPE_CHECKING from collections import deque from enum import Enum from .hand_tracker import Hand from .gesture_types import GestureType, GestureConfig logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) @dataclass @dataclass if __name__ == "__main__": # Test the filter pipeline import sys from pathlib import Path sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent)) from hand_tracker import Hand, Landmark, HandLandmark logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO) print("Testing GestureFilterPipeline...") # Create mock hand config = FilterConfig( confirmation_window_frames=10, min_consecutive_frames=5, finger_stability_frames=3, ) pipeline = GestureFilterPipeline(config) # Test left click gesture print("
1. Testing left click (pinch thumb+index)...") hand = create_hand(index_extended=False, middle_extended=False, thumb_pinched=True) hand._finger_states = {"thumb": True, "index": False, "middle": False, "ring": False, "pinky": False} # Simulate 10 frames of consistent detection for i in range(12): confirmed = pipeline.process(GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, hand, 0.85) if confirmed: print(f" Frame {i}: CONFIRMED! (consecutive: {confirmed.consecutive_frames})") else: print(f" Frame {i}: detecting... (stable states: {pipeline.finger_stability.get_stable_states('Right')})") # Test false positive scenario print("
2. Testing false positive rejection...") pipeline.reset() # Only 3 frames of detection then stop hand2 = create_hand(index_extended=False, thumb_pinched=True) hand2._finger_states = {"thumb": True, "index": False, "middle": False, "ring": False, "pinky": False} for i in range(3): confirmed = pipeline.process(GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, hand2, 0.75) print(f" Frame {i}: {'CONFIRMED' if confirmed else 'detecting'}") # Then no gesture hand_open = create_hand(index_extended=True, thumb_pinched=False) hand_open._finger_states = {"thumb": False, "index": True, "middle": False, "ring": False, "pinky": False} for i in range(5): confirmed = pipeline.process(GestureType.NONE, hand_open, 0.0) print(f" Frame {i+3}: {'CONFIRMED' if confirmed else 'no gesture'}") print(f"
Final stats: {pipeline.get_stats()}") print("
Test complete")

nodes.body_text: class FilterConfig: """Configuration for gesture filtering.""" # Multi-frame confirmation confirmation_window_frames: int = 10 # Total frames to observe (8-12) min_consecutive_frames: int = 5 # Minimum consecutive positive frames (5+) max_gap_frames: int = 2 # Max frames gesture can be missing before reset # Confidence thresholds per gesture type (can be adjusted dynamically) base_confidence_thresholds: Dict[GestureType, float] = field(default_factory=lambda: { GestureType.LEFT_CLICK: 0.75, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK: 0.75, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK: 0.80, GestureType.DOUBLE_CLICK: 0.85, GestureType.DRAG_START: 0.80, GestureType.SCROLL_UP: 0.70, GestureType.SCROLL_DOWN: 0.70, GestureType.SCROLL_HORIZONTAL: 0.70, GestureType.SWIPE_LEFT: 0.80, GestureType.SWIPE_RIGHT: 0.80, GestureType.SWIPE_UP: 0.80, GestureType.SWIPE_DOWN: 0.80, GestureType.PAUSE_TRACKING: 0.85, GestureType.RESUME_TRACKING: 0.60, GestureType.GESTURE_CHORD: 0.90, GestureType.PRECISION_TOGGLE: 0.85, GestureType.PINCH_CONFIRM: 0.75, GestureType.PINCH_END: 0.60, }) # Finger stability finger_stability_frames: int = 3 # Frames to require stable finger state finger_state_change_threshold: float = 0.1 # Min distance change to consider finger moved # Dynamic threshold adjustment adaptive_threshold_enabled: bool = True false_positive_penalty: float = 0.05 # Increase threshold after false positive true_positive_reward: float = 0.02 # Decrease threshold after true positive min_threshold: float = 0.50 max_threshold: float = 0.95 # Pinch-specific thresholds (from GestureConfig) pinch_enter_threshold: float = 0.045 pinch_confirm_threshold: float = 0.040 pinch_release_threshold: float = 0.070

nodes.name: MultiFrameConfirmationFilter
nodes.body_text: class MultiFrameConfirmationFilter: """ Multi-frame confirmation filter for gesture detection. Maintains a sliding window of frame results for each gesture type. A gesture is confirmed only after N consecutive positive frames within a window of M frames (e.g., 5+ out of 10 frames). """ def __init__(self, config: Optional[FilterConfig] = None): self.config = config or FilterConfig() # Track candidates for each gesture type self._candidates: Dict[GestureType, GestureCandidate] = {} # History of recent detection results for statistics self._detection_history: Dict[GestureType, deque] = { gt: deque(maxlen=self.config.confirmation_window_frames) for gt in GestureType if gt != GestureType.NONE } def process(self, gesture_type: GestureType, hand: Hand, confidence: float, finger_states: Dict[str, bool]) -> Optional[GestureCandidate]: """ Process a potential gesture detection. Args: gesture_type: Type of gesture detected hand: Hand that produced the gesture confidence: Detection confidence (0-1) finger_states: Current finger extension states Returns: Confirmed GestureCandidate if confirmed, None otherwise """ if gesture_type == GestureType.NONE: # No gesture - clear any pending candidates self._handle_no_gesture() return None current_time = time.time() threshold = self._get_dynamic_threshold(gesture_type) # Check if confidence meets threshold if confidence < threshold: # Below threshold - candidate fails if gesture_type in self._candidates: self._candidates[gesture_type].consecutive_frames = 0 self._detection_history[gesture_type].append(False) return None # Get index fingertip position for velocity tracking index_tip_pos = None if hand.index_tip: index_tip_pos = (hand.index_tip.x, hand.index_tip.y) # Get or create candidate if gesture_type not in self._candidates: self._candidates[gesture_type] = GestureCandidate( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, start_time=current_time, consecutive_frames=1, total_frames=1, last_confidence=confidence, finger_states=finger_states.copy(), start_position=index_tip_pos or (0.0, 0.0), last_position=index_tip_pos or (0.0, 0.0), last_frame_time=current_time, max_velocity=0.0 ) else: candidate = self._candidates[gesture_type] # Check if hand identity matches (same handedness) if candidate.hand.handedness != hand.handedness: # Hand switched - reset candidate self._candidates[gesture_type] = GestureCandidate( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, start_time=current_time, consecutive_frames=1, total_frames=1, last_confidence=confidence, finger_states=finger_states.copy(), start_position=index_tip_pos or (0.0, 0.0), last_position=index_tip_pos or (0.0, 0.0), last_frame_time=current_time, max_velocity=0.0 ) else: # Same hand - continue tracking with velocity calculation candidate.consecutive_frames += 1 candidate.total_frames += 1 candidate.last_confidence = confidence candidate.finger_states = finger_states.copy() # Calculate velocity if we have position data if index_tip_pos and candidate.last_frame_time > 0: dt = current_time - candidate.last_frame_time if dt > 0: dx = index_tip_pos[0] - candidate.last_position[0] dy = index_tip_pos[1] - candidate.last_position[1] velocity = (dx * dx + dy * dy) ** 0.5 / dt candidate.max_velocity = max(candidate.max_velocity, velocity) candidate.last_position = index_tip_pos or candidate.last_position candidate.last_frame_time = current_time candidate = self._candidates[gesture_type] self._detection_history[gesture_type].append(True) # Check confirmation criteria if self._is_confirmed(candidate): # Gesture confirmed! confirmed_candidate = GestureCandidate( gesture_type=candidate.gesture_type, hand=candidate.hand, start_time=candidate.start_time, consecutive_frames=candidate.consecutive_frames, total_frames=candidate.total_frames, last_confidence=candidate.last_confidence, finger_states=candidate.finger_states.copy() ) # Keep candidate but mark as confirmed (don't delete - state machine needs it) candidate.consecutive_frames = self.config.min_consecutive_frames # Keep at threshold return confirmed_candidate return None def _is_confirmed(self, candidate: GestureCandidate) -> bool: """Check if candidate meets confirmation criteria.""" # Must have enough consecutive frames if candidate.consecutive_frames < self.config.min_consecutive_frames: return False # Must be within the window if candidate.total_frames > self.config.confirmation_window_frames: # Window expired - check if we had enough in the window recent_true = sum(1 for x in self._detection_history[candidate.gesture_type] if x) return recent_true >= self.config.min_consecutive_frames return True def check_safety_conditions(self, candidate: GestureCandidate, gesture_config: GestureConfig) -> Tuple[bool, str]: """ Check false gesture safety conditions for a confirmed candidate. Returns: Tuple of (passes_safety_checks, failure_reason) """ if not candidate: return False, "no_candidate" current_time = time.time() hold_duration = current_time - candidate.start_time # 1. Minimum gesture duration check min_d

reset candidate self._candidates[gesture_type] = GestureCandidate( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, start_time=current_time, consecutive_frames=1, total_frames=1, last_confidence=confidence, finger_states=finger_states.copy(), start_position=index_tip_pos or (0.0, 0.0), last_position=index_tip_pos or (0.0, 0.0), last_frame_time=current_time, max_velocity=0.0 ) else: # Same hand - continue tracking with velocity calculation candidate.consecutive_frames += 1 candidate.total_frames += 1 candidate.last_confidence = confidence candidate.finger_states = finger_states.copy() # Calculate velocity if we have position data if index_tip_pos and candidate.last_frame_time > 0: dt = current_time - candidate.last_frame_time if dt > 0: dx = index_tip_pos[0] - candidate.last_position[0] dy = index_tip_pos[1] - candidate.last_position[1] velocity = (dx * dx + dy * dy) ** 0.5 / dt candidate.max_velocity = max(candidate.max_velocity, velocity) candidate.last_position = index_tip_pos or candidate.last_position candidate.last_frame_time = current_time candidate = self._candidates[gesture_type] self._detection_history[gesture_type].append(True) # Check confirmation criteria if self._is_confirmed(candidate): # Gesture confirmed! confirmed_candidate = GestureCandidate( gesture_type=candidate.gesture_type, hand=candidate.hand, start_time=candidate.start_time, consecutive_frames=candidate.consecutive_frames, total_frames=candidate.total_frames, last_confidence=candidate.last_confidence, finger_states=candidate.finger_states.copy() ) # Keep candidate but mark as confirmed (don't delete - state machine needs it) candidate.consecutive_frames = self.config.min_consecutive_frames # Keep at threshold return confirmed_candidate return None

nodes.name: _is_confirmed
nodes.body_text: def _is_confirmed(self, candidate: GestureCandidate) -> bool: """Check if candidate meets confirmation criteria.""" # Must have enough consecutive frames if candidate.consecutive_frames < self.config.min_consecutive_frames: return False # Must be within the window if candidate.total_frames > self.config.confirmation_window_frames: # Window expired - check if we had enough in the window recent_true = sum(1 for x in self._detection_history[candidate.gesture_type] if x) return recent_true >= self.config.min_consecutive_frames return True

nodes.name: check_safety_conditions
nodes.signature: def check_safety_conditions(self, candidate: GestureCandidate, gesture_config: GestureConfig) -> Tuple[bool, str]
nodes.body_text: def check_safety_conditions(self, candidate: GestureCandidate, gesture_config: GestureConfig) -> Tuple[bool, str]: """ Check false gesture safety conditions for a confirmed candidate. Returns: Tuple of (passes_safety_checks, failure_reason) """ if not candidate: return False, "no_candidate" current_time = time.time() hold_duration = current_time - candidate.start_time # 1. Minimum gesture duration check min_duration = gesture_config.min_gesture_duration if candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK): min_duration = gesture_config.min_pinch_duration elif candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.SCROLL_UP, GestureType.SCROLL_DOWN, GestureType.SCROLL_HORIZONTAL): min_duration = gesture_config.min_scroll_duration elif candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.SWIPE_LEFT, GestureType.SWIPE_RIGHT, GestureType.SWIPE_UP, GestureType.SWIPE_DOWN): min_duration = gesture_config.min_swipe_duration if hold_duration < min_duration: return False, f"duration_too_short: {hold_duration:.3f}s < {min_duration:.3f}s" # 2. Velocity gate check max_velocity = gesture_config.max_click_velocity if candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK): max_velocity = gesture_config.max_pinch_velocity elif candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.SCROLL_UP, GestureType.SCROLL_DOWN, GestureType.SCROLL_HORIZONTAL): max_velocity = gesture_config.max_scroll_velocity if candidate.max_velocity > max_velocity: return False, f"velocity_too_high: {candidate.max_velocity:.3f} > {max_velocity:.3f}" # 3. Anti-flicker consecutive frames check min_frames = gesture_config.min_consecutive_frames if candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK): min_frames = gesture_config.min_pinch_frames elif candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.SCROLL_UP, GestureType.SCROLL_DOWN, GestureType.SCROLL_HORIZONTAL): min_frames = gesture_config.min_scroll_frames elif candidate.gesture_type in (GestureType.SWIPE_LEFT, GestureType.SWIPE_RIGHT, GestureType.SWIPE_UP, GestureType.SWIPE_DOWN): min_frames = gesture_config.min_swipe_frames if candidate.consecutive_frames < min_frames: return False, f"insufficient_frames: {candidate.consecutive_frames} < {min_frames}" return True, "passed"

nodes.name: check_palm_occlusion
nodes.body_text: def check_palm_occlusion(self, hand: Hand) -> bool: """Check if palm is visible for pinch gestures (anti-false-positive).""" # Check wrist and palm landmarks visibility # Wrist (0) and palm base landmarks should be visible if hand.wrist and hand.wrist.visibility < 0.5: return False # Check MCP joints (palm base) - landmarks 1, 5, 9, 13, 17 palm_landmarks = [0, 1, 5, 9, 13, 17] # wrist + MCP joints visible_count = 0 for idx in palm_landmarks: if idx < len(hand.landmarks) and hand.landmarks[idx].visibility >= 0.3: visible_count += 1 # At least 4 out of 6 palm landmarks should be visible return visible_count >= 4

nodes.name: _handle_no_gesture
nodes.body_text: def _handle_no_gesture(self): """Handle frame with no gesture detected.""" for gt in self._candidates: candidate = self._candidates[gt] candidate.total_frames += 1 # Check if gap exceeds max allowed if candidate.total_frames - candidate.consecutive_frames > self.config.max_gap_frames: # Gap too large - reset candidate.consecutive_frames = 0 self._detection_history[gt].append(False) # Clean up expired candidates expired = [ gt for gt, c in self._candidates.items() if c.total_frames > self.config.confirmation_window_frames + self.config.max_gap_frames ] for gt in expired: del self._candidates[gt]

nodes.name: _get_dynamic_threshold
nodes.body_text: def _get_dynamic_threshold(self, gesture_type: GestureType) -> float: """Get dynamic confidence threshold for gesture type.""" base = self.config.base_confidence_thresholds.get(gesture_type, 0.7) return max(self.config.min_threshold, min(self.config.max_threshold, base))

nodes.name: record_result
nodes.signature: def record_result(self, gesture_type: GestureType, was_true_positive: bool)
nodes.body_text: def record_result(self, gesture_type: GestureType, was_true_positive: bool): """Record outcome for adaptive threshold adjustment.""" if not self.config.adaptive_threshold_enabled: return if gesture_type not in self.config.base_confidence_thresholds: return current = self.config.base_confidence_thresholds[gesture_type] if was_true_positive: # Reward: slightly lower threshold self.config.base_confidence_thresholds[gesture_type] = max( self.config.min_threshold, current - self.config.true_positive_reward ) else: # Penalty: increase threshold self.config.base_confidence_thresholds[gesture_type] = min( self.config.max_threshold, current + self.config.false_positive_penalty ) logger.debug(f"Adjusted threshold for {gesture_type.name}: {current:.3f} -> {self.config.base_confidence_thresholds[gesture_type]:.3f}")

nodes.body_text: def reset(self): """Reset all filter state.""" self._candidates.clear() for history in self._detection_history.values(): history.clear()

nodes.body_text: def get_candidate(self, gesture_type: GestureType) -> Optional[GestureCandidate]: """Get current candidate for a gesture type (for state machine integration).""" return self._candidates.get(gesture_type)

nodes.name: ConfidenceThresholder
nodes.body_text: class ConfidenceThresholder: """ Dynamic per-gesture confidence thresholding. Maintains separate confidence thresholds for each gesture type that adapt based on recent detection accuracy. """ def __init__(self, config: Optional[FilterConfig] = None): self.config = config or FilterConfig() self._thresholds: Dict[GestureType, float] = self.config.base_confidence_thresholds.copy() self._recent_detections: Dict[GestureType, deque] = { gt: deque(maxlen=20) for gt in GestureType if gt != GestureType.NONE } self._false_positive_count: Dict[GestureType, int] = {gt: 0 for gt in GestureType if gt != GestureType.NONE} self._true_positive_count: Dict[GestureType, int] = {gt: 0 for gt in GestureType if gt != GestureType.NONE} def get_threshold(self, gesture_type: GestureType) -> float: """Get current threshold for gesture type.""" return self._thresholds.get(gesture_type, 0.7) def check_confidence(self, gesture_type: GestureType, confidence: float) -> bool: """Check if confidence meets threshold.""" return confidence >= self.get_threshold(gesture_type) def record_detection(self, gesture_type: GestureType, confidence: float, was_correct: bool): """Record detection result for adaptive thresholding.""" if gesture_type == GestureType.NONE: return self._recent_detections[gesture_type].append((confidence, was_correct)) if was_correct: self._true_positive_count[gesture_type] += 1 else: self._false_positive_count[gesture_type] += 1 # Adjust threshold based on recent performance self._adjust_threshold(gesture_type) def _adjust_threshold(self, gesture_type: GestureType): """Adjust threshold based on recent detection history.""" history = self._recent_detections[gesture_type] if len(history) < 5: return # Need minimum history # Calculate recent false positive rate recent_false = sum(1 for _, correct in history if not correct) total = len(history) false_rate = recent_false / total current_threshold = self._thresholds[gesture_type] if false_rate > 0.3: # High false positive rate # Increase threshold self._thresholds[gesture_type] = min( self.config.max_threshold, current_threshold + self.config.false_positive_penalty ) elif false_rate < 0.1 and self._true_positive_count[gesture_type] > 10: # Low false positive rate and enough true positives - can lower threshold self._thresholds[gesture_type] = max( self.config.min_threshold, current_threshold - self.config.true_positive_reward ) def get_stats(self) -> Dict[GestureType, dict]: """Get threshold statistics for all gestures.""" stats = {} for gt in GestureType: if gt == GestureType.NONE: continue history = self._recent_detections[gt] if history: false_rate = sum(1 for _, c in history if not c) / len(history) else: false_rate = 0.0 stats[gt] = { "threshold": self._thresholds.get(gt, 0.7), "false_positive_rate": false_rate, "true_positives": self._true_positive_count[gt], "false_positives": self._false_positive_count[gt], "recent_samples": len(history), } return stats def reset(self): """Reset all thresholds to defaults.""" self._thresholds = self.config.base_confidence_thresholds.copy() for history in self._recent_detections.values(): history.clear() self._false_positive_count = {gt: 0 for gt in GestureType if gt != GestureType.NONE} self._true_positive_count = {gt: 0 for gt in GestureType if gt != GestureType.NONE}

nodes.name: FingerStabilityFilter
nodes.body_text: class FingerStabilityFilter: """ Finger extension state stability filter. Requires finger extension states to remain consistent for N frames before accepting a gesture that depends on specific finger states. """ def __init__(self, config: Optional[FilterConfig] = None): self.config = config or FilterConfig() # Track finger state history per hand (by handedness) self._finger_history: Dict[str, deque] = {} # handedness -> deque of finger states self._stable_states: Dict[str, Dict[str, bool]] = {} # handedness -> stable finger states def update(self, handedness: str, finger_states: Dict[str, bool]) -> Dict[str, bool]: """ Update finger state history and return stabilized states. Args: handedness: Hand identifier ("Left" or "Right") finger_states: Current finger extension states Returns: Stabilized finger states (only states stable for N frames) """ if handedness not in self._finger_history: self._finger_history[handedness] = deque(maxlen=self.config.finger_stability_frames) self._stable_states[handedness] = {} history = self._finger_history[handedness] history.append(finger_states.copy()) # Need enough frames if len(history) < self.config.finger_stability_frames: return {} # Not enough history yet # Check stability: all frames in history must have same state for each finger stabilized = {} fingers = ["thumb", "index", "middle", "ring", "pinky"] for finger in fingers: states = [frame.get(finger, False) for frame in history] if all(s == states[0] for s in states): # Stable stabilized[finger] = states[0] else: # Not stable - use previous stable state or current stabilized[finger] = self._stable_states[handedness].get(finger, finger_states.get(finger, False)) self._stable_states[handedness] = stabilized return stabilized def is_stable(self, handedness: str, finger: str) -> bool: """Check if a specific finger state is stable.""" if handedness not in self._finger_history: return False if len(self._finger_history[handedness]) < self.config.finger_stability_frames: return False history = self._finger_history[handedness] states = [frame.get(finger, False) for frame in history] return all(s == states[0] for s in states) def get_stable_states(self, handedness: str) -> Dict[str, bool]: """Get current stable finger states for a hand.""" return self._stable_states.get(handedness, {}).copy() def reset(self, handedness: Optional[str] = None): """Reset filter state for a hand or all hands.""" if handedness: self._finger_history.pop(handedness, None) self._stable_states.pop(handedness, None) else: self._finger_history.clear() self._stable_states.clear()

nodes.name: GestureFilterPipeline
nodes.body_text: class GestureFilterPipeline: """ Complete gesture filtering pipeline combining all filters. Flow: 1. Raw gesture detection from GestureRecognizer 2. Confidence thresholding (ConfidenceThresholder) 3. Finger stability check (FingerStabilityFilter) 4. Multi-frame confirmation (MultiFrameConfirmationFilter) 5. Output confirmed gestures """ def __init__(self, config: Optional[FilterConfig] = None): self.config = config or FilterConfig() self.confidence_filter = ConfidenceThresholder(config) self.finger_stability = FingerStabilityFilter(config) self.confirmation_filter = MultiFrameConfirmationFilter(config) def process(self, gesture_type: GestureType, hand: Hand, raw_confidence: float) -> Optional[GestureCandidate]: """ Process a raw gesture detection through the full pipeline. Args: gesture_type: Detected gesture type hand: Hand that produced the gesture raw_confidence: Raw detection confidence from recognizer Returns: Confirmed GestureCandidate if passed all filters, None otherwise """ if gesture_type == GestureType.NONE: # Handle no-gesture frame self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() # Still update finger stability for active hands if hand and hand.handedness: self.finger_stability.update(hand.handedness, hand.finger_states) return None if not hand or not hand.handedness: return None # Step 1: Confidence thresholding if not self.confidence_filter.check_confidence(gesture_type, raw_confidence): self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() return None # Step 2: Finger stability check stable_states = self.finger_stability.update(hand.handedness, hand.finger_states) # For gestures requiring specific finger states, verify stability if not stable_states: # Not enough history for stability yet - still track detection in confirmation filter # but don't verify finger states yet confirmed = self.confirmation_filter.process( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, confidence=raw_confidence, finger_states={} # Empty - not yet stable ) return confirmed # After warmup, verify finger states match gesture requirements if not self._verify_finger_states_for_gesture(gesture_type, stable_states): self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() return None # Step 3: Multi-frame confirmation confirmed = self.confirmation_filter.process( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, confidence=raw_confidence, finger_states=stable_states ) return confirmed def _verify_finger_states_for_gesture(self, gesture_type: GestureType, stable_states: Dict[str, bool]) -> bool: """Verify stable finger states match gesture requirements.""" if not stable_states: return False # Not enough stability data yet # Gesture-specific finger requirements requirements = { # For pinch gestures, the pinching fingers are FOLDED (touching thumb) GestureType.LEFT_CLICK: {"index": False, "middle": False}, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK: {"middle": False, "index": False}, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK: {"ring": False, "index": False, "middle": False}, GestureType.DOUBLE_CLICK: {"index": False, "middle": False}, # Same as left click GestureType.DRAG_START: {"index": False, "middle": False}, GestureType.SCROLL_UP: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, GestureType.SCROLL_DOWN: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, GestureType.SCROLL_HORIZONTAL: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, GestureType.SWIPE_LEFT: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.SWIPE_RIGHT: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.SWIPE_UP: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.SWIPE_DOWN: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.PAUSE_TRACKING: {"index": False, "middle": False, "ring": False, "pinky": False, "thumb": False}, GestureType.RESUME_TRACKING: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, # Open hand GestureType.PRECISION_TOGGLE: {"index": True, "middle": False, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, # Pointing } req = requirements.get(gesture_type) if not req: return True # No specific requirements for finger, required_state in req.items(): if stable_states.get(finger) != required_state: return False return True def record_outcome(self, gesture_type: GestureType, was_true_positive: bool): """Record gesture outcome for adaptive filtering.""" self.confirmation_filter.record_result(gesture_type, was_true_positive) self.confidence_filter.record_detection(gesture_type, 0.8, was_true_positive) # placeholder confidence def get_stats(self) -> dict: """Get comprehensive filter statistics.""" return { "confirmation_history": { gt.name: len(hist) for gt, hist in self.confirmation_filter._detection_history.items() }, "confidence_thresholds": self.confidence_filter.get_stats(), "finger_stability": { handedness: len(hist) for handedness, hist in self.finger_stability._finger_history.items() }, } def reset(self): """Reset all filters.""" self.confidence_filter.reset() self.finger_stability.reset() s

Args: gesture_type: Detected gesture type hand: Hand that produced the gesture raw_confidence: Raw detection confidence from recognizer Returns: Confirmed GestureCandidate if passed all filters, None otherwise """ if gesture_type == GestureType.NONE: # Handle no-gesture frame self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() # Still update finger stability for active hands if hand and hand.handedness: self.finger_stability.update(hand.handedness, hand.finger_states) return None if not hand or not hand.handedness: return None # Step 1: Confidence thresholding if not self.confidence_filter.check_confidence(gesture_type, raw_confidence): self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() return None # Step 2: Finger stability check stable_states = self.finger_stability.update(hand.handedness, hand.finger_states) # For gestures requiring specific finger states, verify stability if not stable_states: # Not enough history for stability yet - still track detection in confirmation filter # but don't verify finger states yet confirmed = self.confirmation_filter.process( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, confidence=raw_confidence, finger_states={} # Empty - not yet stable ) return confirmed # After warmup, verify finger states match gesture requirements if not self._verify_finger_states_for_gesture(gesture_type, stable_states): self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() return None # Step 3: Multi-frame confirmation confirmed = self.confirmation_filter.process( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, confidence=raw_confidence, finger_states=stable_states ) return confirmed

nodes.signature: def _verify_finger_states_for_gesture(self, gesture_type: GestureType, stable_states: Dict[str, bool]) -> bool
nodes.body_text: def _verify_finger_states_for_gesture(self, gesture_type: GestureType, stable_states: Dict[str, bool]) -> bool: """Verify stable finger states match gesture requirements.""" if not stable_states: return False # Not enough stability data yet # Gesture-specific finger requirements requirements = { # For pinch gestures, the pinching fingers are FOLDED (touching thumb) GestureType.LEFT_CLICK: {"index": False, "middle": False}, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK: {"middle": False, "index": False}, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK: {"ring": False, "index": False, "middle": False}, GestureType.DOUBLE_CLICK: {"index": False, "middle": False}, # Same as left click GestureType.DRAG_START: {"index": False, "middle": False}, GestureType.SCROLL_UP: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, GestureType.SCROLL_DOWN: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, GestureType.SCROLL_HORIZONTAL: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, GestureType.SWIPE_LEFT: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.SWIPE_RIGHT: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.SWIPE_UP: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.SWIPE_DOWN: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, GestureType.PAUSE_TRACKING: {"index": False, "middle": False, "ring": False, "pinky": False, "thumb": False}, GestureType.RESUME_TRACKING: {"index": True, "middle": True, "ring": True, "pinky": True}, # Open hand GestureType.PRECISION_TOGGLE: {"index": True, "middle": False, "ring": False, "pinky": False}, # Pointing } req = requirements.get(gesture_type) if not req: return True # No specific requirements for finger, required_state in req.items(): if stable_states.get(finger) != required_state: return False return True

nodes.body_text: def process_with_stable_states(self, gesture_type: GestureType, hand: Hand, raw_confidence: float, stable_states: Dict[str, bool]) -> Optional[GestureCandidate]: """ Process a raw gesture detection through the pipeline with pre-computed stable states. This is used when the finger stability filter has already been run for this frame (e.g., in GestureStateMachine which processes multiple gesture types per frame). Args: gesture_type: Detected gesture type hand: Hand that produced the gesture raw_confidence: Raw detection confidence from recognizer stable_states: Pre-computed stable finger states from finger_stability_filter.process() Returns: Confirmed GestureCandidate if passed all filters, None otherwise """ if gesture_type == GestureType.NONE: # Handle no-gesture frame self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() return None if not hand or not hand.handedness: return None # Step 1: Confidence thresholding if not self.confidence_filter.check_confidence(gesture_type, raw_confidence): self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() return None # Step 2: Use pre-computed finger stability states if not stable_states: # Not enough history for stability yet - don't reset candidate, just wait # Still call confirmation_filter to track consecutive frames during warmup confirmed = self.confirmation_filter.process( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, confidence=raw_confidence, finger_states={} # Empty - not yet stable ) return confirmed if not self._verify_finger_states_for_gesture(gesture_type, stable_states): self.confirmation_filter._handle_no_gesture() return None # Step 3: Multi-frame confirmation confirmed = self.confirmation_filter.process( gesture_type=gesture_type, hand=hand, confidence=raw_confidence, finger_states=stable_states ) return confirmed

""" Gesture State Machine Module for Air Mouse Implements explicit state machine for gesture lifecycle: IDLE -> DETECTING -> CONFIRMED -> ACTIVE -> RELEASING -> IDLE Provides robust gesture lifecycle management with clear transitions, timeout handling, and integration with GestureFilterPipeline. """ import time import logging from dataclasses import dataclass, field from typing import Optional, Dict, List, Tuple, Callable from enum import Enum, auto from .hand_tracker import Hand from .gesture_types import GestureType, TrackingState, GestureConfig from .gesture_filter import GestureFilterPipeline, FilterConfig logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) @dataclass @dataclass if __name__ == "__main__": # Test the state machine import sys from pathlib import Path sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent)) from hand_tracker import Hand, Landmark, HandLandmark logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG) print("Testing GestureStateMachine...") # Create mock hand # Create state machine config = GestureConfig() filter_config = FilterConfig() sm = GestureStateMachine(config, filter_config) events_received = [] sm.set_gesture_callback(on_event) sm.set_transition_callback(on_transition) # Simulate frames print("
--- Test 1: Left click (pinch) ---") hand = create_hand(index_extended=True, thumb_pinched=True) for i in range(15): events = sm.process(hand, time.time() + i * 0.033) print(f"Frame {i}: states={sm.get_all_states()}") # Release hand = create_hand(index_extended=True, thumb_pinched=False) for i in range(5): events = sm.process(hand, time.time() + 15 * 0.033 + i * 0.033) print(f"Frame {15+i}: states={sm.get_all_states()}") print("
--- Test 2: Drag (hold + move) ---") sm.reset() hand = create_hand(index_extended=True, thumb_pinched=True) for i in range(15): if i >= 10: # Move hand hand.index_tip.x = 0.5 + (i - 10) * 0.02 hand.index_tip.y = 0.3 + (i - 10) * 0.02 events = sm.process(hand, time.time() + i * 0.033) print(f"Frame {i}: states={sm.get_all_states()}") # Release hand = create_hand(index_extended=True, thumb_pinched=False) for i in range(5): events = sm.process(hand, time.time() + 15 * 0.033 + i * 0.033) print(f"Frame {15+i}: states={sm.get_all_states()}") print("
--- Test 3: Fist pause/resume ---") sm.reset() hand = create_hand(fist=True) for i in range(20): events = sm.process(hand, time.time() + i * 0.033) print(f"Frame {i}: states={sm.get_all_states()}, paused={sm.is_tracking_paused()}") hand = create_hand(fist=False) for i in range(5): events = sm.process(hand, time.time() + 20 * 0.033 + i * 0.033) print(f"Frame {20+i}: states={sm.get_all_states()}, paused={sm.is_tracking_paused()}") print("
Done!")

nodes.name: GestureState
nodes.body_text: class GestureState(Enum): """Explicit gesture states for lifecycle management.""" IDLE = "idle" # No gesture in progress DETECTING = "detecting" # Candidate detected, awaiting confirmation CONFIRMED = "confirmed" # Gesture confirmed, active ACTIVE = "active" # Gesture fully active (drag, scroll, hold) RELEASING = "releasing" # Gesture releasing, waiting for clear release COOLDOWN = "cooldown" # Post-release cooldown before next detection

nodes.body_text: class GestureStateData: """Per-gesture state tracking data.""" state: GestureState = GestureState.IDLE hand: Optional[Hand] = None start_time: float = 0.0 confirm_time: float = 0.0 last_update_time: float = 0.0 consecutive_detected: int = 0 consecutive_missed: int = 0 was_active: bool = False # For drag detection start_position: Tuple[float, float] = (0.0, 0.0) # Cursor position holding for smooth transitions cursor_position_at_confirm: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None cursor_position_at_active: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None cursor_hold_position: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None metadata: Dict = field(default_factory=dict)

nodes.name: GestureStateMachine
nodes.body_text: class GestureStateMachine: """ Explicit state machine for gesture lifecycle management. State transitions: - IDLE -> DETECTING: Raw gesture detected (above enter threshold) - DETECTING -> CONFIRMED: Multi-frame confirmation met (5+ of 10 frames) - DETECTING -> IDLE: Gesture lost (below enter threshold for max_gap_frames) - CONFIRMED -> ACTIVE: Hold time met or movement threshold exceeded - CONFIRMED -> RELEASING: Release threshold crossed - ACTIVE -> RELEASING: Release threshold crossed - RELEASING -> IDLE: Clear release confirmed (above release threshold) - RELEASING -> ACTIVE: Re-confirmation (hysteresis) - Any -> COOLDOWN: Force transition (e.g., hand lost) - COOLDOWN -> IDLE: Cooldown period elapsed """ def __init__(self, config: Optional[GestureConfig] = None, filter_config: Optional[FilterConfig] = None): self.config = config or GestureConfig() self.filter_config = filter_config or FilterConfig( confirmation_window_frames=10, min_consecutive_frames=5, finger_stability_frames=3, pinch_enter_threshold=self.config.pinch_enter_threshold, pinch_confirm_threshold=self.config.pinch_confirm_threshold, pinch_release_threshold=self.config.pinch_release_threshold, ) # State tracking per gesture type self._gesture_states: Dict[GestureType, GestureStateData] = {} for gt in GestureType: if gt != GestureType.NONE: self._gesture_states[gt] = GestureStateData() # Filter pipeline self._filter_pipeline = GestureFilterPipeline(self.filter_config) # Transition history for debugging self._transition_history: List[GestureTransition] = [] self._max_history = 100 # Global state self._tracking_paused = False self._current_hand: Optional[Hand] = None self._last_frame_time: float = 0.0 # Callbacks self._on_transition: Optional[Callable[[GestureTransition], None]] = None # Events to return from process() self._pending_events: List[Tuple[GestureType, Dict]] = [] self._on_gesture_event: Optional[Callable[[GestureType, Hand, Dict], None]] = None def _queue_event(self, gesture_type: GestureType, hand: Optional[Hand], metadata: Dict): """Queue an event to be returned from process().""" self._pending_events.append((gesture_type, metadata)) # Also call external callback if set if self._on_gesture_event: self._on_gesture_event(gesture_type, hand, metadata) def set_transition_callback(self, callback: Callable[[GestureTransition], None]): """Set callback for state transitions.""" self._on_transition = callback def set_gesture_callback(self, callback: Callable[[GestureType, Hand, Dict], None]): """Set callback for gesture events.""" self._on_gesture_event = callback def _transition(self, gesture_type: GestureType, to_state: GestureState, reason: str, hand: Optional[Hand] = None): """Perform a state transition.""" from_state = self._gesture_states[gesture_type].state if from_state == to_state: return current_time = time.time() self._gesture_states[gesture_type].state = to_state self._gesture_states[gesture_type].last_update_time = current_time transition = GestureTransition( from_state=from_state, to_state=to_state, gesture_type=gesture_type, timestamp=current_time, reason=reason ) self._transition_history.append(transition) if len(self._transition_history) > self._max_history: self._transition_history.pop(0) logger.debug(f"Gesture {gesture_type.name}: {from_state.value} -> {to_state.value} ({reason})") if self._on_transition: self._on_transition(transition) # Handle enter/exit actions self._on_state_enter(gesture_type, to_state, hand, current_time) self._on_state_exit(gesture_type, from_state, hand, current_time) def _on_state_enter(self, gesture_type: GestureType, state: GestureState, hand: Optional[Hand], current_time: float): """Handle state entry actions.""" data = self._gesture_states[gesture_type] if state == GestureState.DETECTING: data.start_time = current_time data.consecutive_detected = 1 data.consecutive_missed = 0 data.hand = hand if hand and gesture_type in (GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK): # Store start position for drag detection if gesture_type == GestureType.LEFT_CLICK and hand.index_tip: data.start_position = (hand.index_tip.x, hand.index_tip.y) elif gesture_type == GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK and hand.middle_tip: data.start_position = (hand.middle_tip.x, hand.middle_tip.y) elif state == GestureState.CONFIRMED: data.confirm_time = current_time data.was_active = False # Store cursor position at confirmation for smooth CONFIRMED→ACTIVE transition if hand and gesture_type in (GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK): if gesture_type == GestureType.LEFT_CLICK and hand.index_tip: data.cursor_position_at_confirm = (hand.index_tip.x, hand.index_tip.y) elif gesture_type == GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK and hand.middle_tip: data.cursor_position_at_confirm = (hand.middle_tip.x, hand.middle_tip.y) # Emit confirmation event - use PINCH_CONFIRM for pinch gestures if gesture_type in (GestureType.LEFT_CLICK, GestureType.RIGHT_CLICK, GestureType.MIDDLE_CLICK): self._queue_
